matching/cl/util.cpp.evidence: Actual SP1 /GL + /LTCG nextbase compile emits all 26 retail bytes with /O1; /O2 differs. This leaf does not establish flags for the rest of util.obj.

matching/cl/mpcl.cpp.evidence: Actual SP1 /GL + /LTCG env_size compile emits all 45 retail bytes with /O1; /O2 differs at offset 13. The empty thread_print body is also exact but does not distinguish optimization flags.

matching/cl/util_watson.cpp.evidence: Actual complete Watson family /GL+/LTCG probes match whole function bodies and independently resolved data/import/literal referents. wchar_t typedef mode and genuine L-empty initializer preserve the observed unsigned-short pointer type; /GF models observed sharing. /O1 is experimental outside the measured family. Explicit /Ob1 on this callee unit as well as the wrapper unit prevents cross-unit inlining and preserves the four observed 9-byte wrappers when the full Watson family is linked.

matching/cl/merr.c.evidence: Installed-era CRT return-zero source uses actual cruntime.h/math.h under _CRTBLD, matching authentic CRT build context. Actual /GL + /LTCG probe emits all three retail bytes. /O1 is an experimental control, not proof of original CRT flags; C++ EH options are excluded from this C unit.

matching/cl/clmain.cpp.evidence: Same source/object probes require the real setter /INCLUDE root to preserve observed cdecl stack ABI; /O1 /Ob1 emits four complete 9-byte retail call wrappers.

matching/cl/dos.cpp.evidence: Complete Filter23B, screen_length92B and redirect22B probes match; redirect additionally requires its evidence-backed real escaped data root, recorded per candidate.

flag_evidence./GL: Compiler-owned Rich header objects; actual synthetic and genuine source /GL + /LTCG probes succeed with both installed SP1 and isolated RTM tools. This establishes support, while optimization/suboptions and the bootstrap compiler remain provisional.
flag_evidence./MD: Dynamic CRT imports and startup objects; exact startup flags remain provisional.
flag_evidence./EHsc: C++ exception support provisional; exact exception suboptions require probes.

crt_code.notes: Do not apply compiler-owned /GL evidence to plain CRT C/C++/MASM objects. Era source provenance and flags need per-unit evidence.

notes: No probe has pinned optimization, packing, calling convention, RTTI, or exception suboptions.
